headline: Executive order gives the Holy See's observer mission to the United Nations certain legal privileges and immunities in the US.
what_it_does: This order extends legal privileges and immunities to the Permanent Observer Mission of the Holy See (the Vatican's government) at the United Nations in New York. These protections are the kind usually given to diplomatic missions, such as certain protections from lawsuits or other legal action. The title does not list the exact privileges granted.

who_it_affects.group: The Holy See's Permanent Observer Mission to the UN and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The mission and its members receive legal privileges and immunities while in the United States.

when_it_takes_effect: 2007-03-07 (date signed; no separate effective date given)
